title: crossingLower: a slack lower bound at the sampled crossing bucket
statement: For a<=b, eps>0: a + eps*(crossingIndex(a,b,eps) - 3/2) <= b. The matching SLACK lower bound to crossingUpper -- again deliberately not the tight bracket, for the same undecidability reason.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.crossingLower : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : Rat) -> ((x3 : Rat.lt Rat.zero x2) -> ((x4 : CReal.le x0 x1) -> CReal.le (CReal.add x0 (CReal.mul (CReal.ofRat x2) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.add (Rat.natDivSucc (CReal.bucketIndex (CReal.mul (CReal.ofRat (Rat.inv x2)) (CReal.add x1 (CReal.neg x0))) AxNat.zero) AxNat.zero) (Rat.neg (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))) (AxNat.mul (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)))))))) x1)))))
